title: Lava Protocol
tagline: A Bitcoin yield aggregator on Citrea, offering multiple vault strategies to earn yield on your BTC.
description:
LAVA PROTOCOL
Unlocking Bitcoin's Trillion-Dollar Yield Economy

Bitcoin: A Trillion-Dollar Asset, Asleep at the Wheel
A non-custodial, fully automated yield aggregator that transforms cBTC into a productive, yield-bearing asset. Live on Citrea Testnet today where you can Deposit cBTC and Earn More cBTC.

Two Intelligent Vaults for Every Strategy
A vault (the Brain) controlling simple strategies (the Hands). Funds are isolated, and we can add new strategies without redeploying the vault.

Use Bitcoin’s liquidity as collateral to access yield anywhere, then bring profits back to Citrea. User gets a simple deposit/withdraw experience.

Fixed BTC price for demo: $119670
Reserve: 20% of new deposits; remaining split by live on-chain bps
Adapters isolate strategy risk; allocations are owner-adjustable

How the Yield Engine Flows (Both Vaults)
User -> deposits cBTC →Vault -> wraps to WcBTC → keeps Reserve 20%
Portfolio routes remaining by on-chain bps:
Zentra 80%
Satsuma 0%
Cross-Chain 0%
Institutional 0%
Zentra supplies WcBTC (earns Supply APY). If leverage is enabled, borrow small USDC, loop safely (HF>1.0).
Satsuma deposits into Ichi‑managed cBTC vault (fees + emissions, managed range).
Cross-Chain supplies WcBTC → borrows ~20% USDC (LTV) → bridge out → yield source accrues profit → harvest pulls back & repays debt.
Institutional allocates to institutional‑grade sources via bridge, returns profit periodically.
Harvest profits repay debt first (if any), then increase WcBTC collateral → NAV rises → user’s vault tokens are worth more cBTC.
